_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The capabilities generator fails if the source names below do not match the probe exactly, and the integration suite restores from the images listed under verified — the baseline on every run, the rest in the scheduled version matrix and before a release tag — so neither can drift. The image starts the server itself, so the sandbox needs no command override; the adapter waits for the REST endpoint, which comes up about 1.9 s after the native client (measured), because that is the path every check takes. Measured on both verified lines: the restore runs at 256 MiB, taosdump exits 0 whether it restored everything, half a damaged backup or nothing at all, and a 3.3.6.13 artifact restores into 3.3.5.8. TDengine publishes no end-of-life dates, so supported_until is null. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: TDengine

sources.taosdump: One `taosdump` output directory, named at either level
sources.taosdump_dir: A directory of them; the newest by the dumps' own recorded instant is restored
sources.taosdump_tar: One tar archive of a taosdump output directory
